author: doooom
quote: I do like the girl on the cover, who is good looking and in good shape. And in the game what they gave to me? And the dev mandate me the MC to date with that lady, she is not the girl on the cover. It is a scam. I appreciate the open world they made, and also don't like the restrictions, for example why I can't shoot the protestors? Why are they special from other NPC? The dev tell me is OK to kill an American soldier and rob a poor grocery store but can't kill the liberal protestors. If killing is incorrect, why not just disable it? And the story line ****, look at Skyrim and look at the MC here.
